full_page.content:
1924, December
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 18 Cont.
Dec. 4 Running Artery Cured. Mrs. McInnes (Undertakers wife)
5th Asks for 6 foot Hole in the Grave-yard.
5 th Hopes of Yesterday seem Realized To-night. Mrs. Rose M. Moraine anxious about business - prospects of husband enrolls him for year yesterday comes back this evening quite enthusiastic at out- look since last night - They live a 398 East Grand Boul.
5th Father away from Church Two years Enrolled by anxious Son. Theo- pholis Rohr 65 yrs old away from practic of religion for two years - Children of second wife taken out of Cath. School. Es- tranged and bitter against older children and against religion. Is enrolled for year by oldest Son, who reports a week later "Father is completely changed." Son Frank Rohr
6 Mrs. Julia Stockwell, Mack & Defer Rd. Grooe Pt. Farms. Mother of 4 Children 105 fever Enrolled this Saturday by distracted young husband at 10.15. Sunday at 9.15 tells us she's feeling greatly improved. Monday at 9 p.m. declared out of danger - positively a wonder.
7 Threatened Victim of Pneumonia enrolled over Phone. 11 months - old Margaret Gibson of 1837 Henry St. is enrolled to-night at 9 o'cl in high fever and pneumonia. Dec. 8 child reported some better - Dec. 9th well out of danger.
8 Fred Maguire (23 of 2269 Harding) in preparation for gaul-stone operation asks this evening to go to confession, enrolling him- self for year in S.M.A.
8 C.H. catholic Expecting to marry spiritest - son of medium - in January - enrolled to-night
9 Feeble-minded 7 year-old, Henry Platt
10 Mrs. Florine Marentette 1332 Bevidere Enrolled August 30 against general brakedown - expected to die before Xmas '24 with consump- tion - 2 yrs also against finantial difficulties reports to-day "Wonderfully improved." Now enrolls husband on verge of insanity and also finantial difficulties.
Page 19 Dec. 15 Complete Deafness - Robert Faret 22 yrs. operated for tonsalitis - adnoids a year ago is become entirely deaf. Enrolled To-day for year.
